zh.title: 波音737 MAX 7與MAX 10完成飛行測試 朝2027年交機邁進
zh.summary: 波音公司表示，737 MAX 7與737 MAX 10兩款機型已於7月完成認證飛行測試，仍預期在2026年取得認證、2027年展開首架交機。該消息與波音第二季財報一同揭露。
body: 波音公司旗下737 MAX家族中最後兩款等待認證的機型——737 MAX 7與737 MAX 10——已正式完成認證飛行測試。該訊息由波音在2026年第二季財報中揭露，Simple Flying於7月28日報導指出，兩款衍生機型是MAX家族中最後尚待取證的機型。
波音在財報中表示，截至7月，737-7與737-10的認證飛行測試均已完竣，公司持續預期兩款機型將在2026年取得認證，並在2027年進行首次交付。同一份財報亦揭露波音第二季營收為246億美元。
737 MAX 7與MAX 10分別為MAX系列中機身最短與最長的版本，兩者完成飛行測試意味著波音在MAX全產品線商業化進程上取得階段性進展，但實際投入營運時間仍需視監管機構最終審查進度而定。

en.title: Boeing Completes 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 Flight Testing, Clearing Path for 2027 Deliveries
en.summary: Boeing has completed certification flight testing on the 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 as of July, and continues to anticipate certification in 2026 with first deliveries in 2027 for both variants, according to the company's second quarter financial release.
body: The Boeing Company has completed certification flight testing on both the 737 MAX 7 and 737 MAX 10, marking a significant step for the final two variants of the MAX family awaiting regulatory approval. The development was disclosed in Boeing's second quarter 2026 financial results and reported by Simple Flying on 28 July.

According to Boeing, 'As of July, certification flight testing has been completed on both the 737-7 and 737-10. The company continues to anticipate certification in 2026 and first delivery in 2027 for both variants.' The Q2 results also showed revenue of $24.6 billion and 171 commercial airplane deliveries.

The 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 are the smallest and largest members of the MAX family respectively. Completion of flight testing allows Boeing to proceed with the final certification documentation, though the actual timelines remain subject to regulatory review.
